goal: PROVOWARE Development Control Plane V2 in zwei abhaengigen Governance-Schritten ausschliesslich im Shadow Mode aufbauen. Schritt 1 fuehrt eine zentrale maschinenlesbare Projekt-/Pfad-/Capability-Registry, einen deterministischen fail-closed Validator und isolierte Governance-Selbsttests ein. Bestehende Gates und Agenten bleiben autoritativ; kein Produktcode wird ueber die Registry geschrieben. Schritt 2 darf erst nach gruenem Zwischen-Gate Rollenrechte, Lifecycle-Zustaende und Trigger als ebenfalls nicht-autoritative Shadow-Vertraege in denselben vier Dateien ergaenzen.

guide_delta.topic: Development Control Plane V2 Shadow Registry
guide_delta.summary: I120 aendert keine Produktfunktion. Schritt 1 beschreibt und validiert den bestehenden sicheren Projektzustand erstmals zentral und maschinenlesbar: genau ein Produkt-Writer, read-only Pruefer/Planer/Validator, Frozen-Pfade sowie die I119-gepruefte MASK_PROPERTIES_V1-Baseline.

direct_dependencies: I119 real Chromium property baseline merged green at 100/150/200 percent
legacy iteration-gate protected paths remain authoritative during shadow mode
existing .provoware/agents rules and roles remain authoritative during shadow mode
tests_required: Step 1: compile control-plane validator and governance test
Step 1: validate the real registry as SHADOW and non-authoritative
Step 1: fail closed if single_product_writer is disabled
Step 1: fail closed if inspectors, planner or validator gain write authority
Step 1: fail closed if a FROZEN path enables automatic writes
Step 1: fail closed if a legacy protected path disappears or no longer requires deep gate
Step 1: fail closed if MASK_PROPERTIES_V1 evidence is missing or non-green
Step 1: fail closed if latest_product_iteration drifts from product manifests
Step 1: fail closed if persistence opens or shadow mode becomes authoritative
Step 2 only after green: add role permissions, lifecycle state machine and trigger contracts in the same registry/validator/test scope
Step 2 only after green: remain SHADOW and non-authoritative; no writer routing yet
deep governance and repository foundation gates
tests_explicitly_not_run: product browser tests because I120 Step 1 changes no product code
database/repository tests because no persistence or core path changes
full suite because this is an isolated governance/control-plane foundation
risks: shadow registry must not accidentally become a second authoritative source before comparison evidence exists
legacy protected paths must be represented at least as strictly as the current gate router
MASK_PROPERTIES_V1 must reference real green I119 evidence
validator must fail closed without adding third-party dependencies
non_changes: no schema, migration, database, repository or CatalogService changes
no README, TODO or PRODUCT_ROADMAP cleanup
no modification of existing agents.yaml or rules.yaml in Step 1
no GitHub branch-protection or ruleset change
no authoritative write lease or router activation
no event log, task registry or outcome registry yet
expected_side_effects: a non-authoritative machine-readable control registry exists
legacy freeze boundaries and the I119 capability baseline are validated fail-closed
future Control Plane V2 steps can compare decisions against existing governance without changing product behavior
